verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a user access review feature, so there is nothing showing periodic review campaigns across connected apps, in-app reviewer sign-off, or review artifacts being filed to the evidence library. The Evidence Library API endpoints and the Connections docs are adjacent building blocks, not the access-review capability itself, so they earn no credit. A GRC platform could plausibly ship this, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a security engineer, periodic user access reviews run across connected apps in the platform — reviewers sign off in-app and the artifact lands in the evidence library
